purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: The current official Long Xuyên Ward portal publishes land-registration and land-use-right certificate notices. This confirms local registration activity, although post-2025 administrative reorganizations mean the current ward area should not be assumed identical to the WUP 2025 settlement footprint. No anonymous public parcel-vector service was verified.
